# Assessing genomic differentiation using Principal Component Analysis

If populations cluster differently on the PCs, that indicates that some genetic differentiation exists between them.

## Read filtered SNP table and load packages

Also sets the cowplot theme

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

FF_genomes_filtered <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")

```

#### Data Prep for PCA

```{r}
data_pca_long <- FF_genomes_filtered %>% 
  mutate(SNP_ID = paste(CHROM, POS, sep = "_")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
  cols = c(starts_with('freq_'), starts_with('N_')),
  names_to = c(".value", "Population"),
  names_pattern = "(freq|N)_(.*)"
  ) %>% rename(depth = N) %>% 
  # Removes all text after the second underscore,
  # used to remove _G13_sample...
  # this leaves freq_CON1, N_CON1, and so on.
  mutate(Population = str_remove(Population, "_.*"))

data_pca_wide <- data_pca_long %>% 
  dplyr::select(SNP_ID, Population, freq) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = SNP_ID, values_from = freq)

metadata <- data_pca_wide %>% dplyr::select(Population)

data_pca <- data_pca_wide %>% 
  dplyr::select(-Population) %>% 
  as.matrix()

rownames(data_pca) <- data_pca_wide$Population
```

#### Running prcomp for PCA

```{r}
pca_result_raw <- prcomp(data_pca, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
```

#### Extract PCA coordinates and find clustering patterns

```{r}
# create dataframe of PC1, PC2, PC3
pca_result <- data.frame(
  X = pca_result_raw$x[, 1], 
  Y = pca_result_raw$x[, 2],
  Z = pca_result_raw$x[, 3]
) # PC1, PC2, PC3


# find variance explained by each PC
var_expl <- pca_result_raw$sdev^2
var_expl_percent <- round((var_expl/sum(var_expl)) * 100, 2)

# add rownames (populations)
pca_result <- cbind(metadata, pca_result)

# separate Selection and PopReplicate as factors
pca_result <- pca_result %>% mutate(
  Population = str_remove(Population, "_.*")) %>%
  separate_wider_regex(
    cols = Population,
    patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")
    ) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate"), factor)

```

#### Make Biplot

```{r}
pca_biplot_Sel <- ggplot(data = pca_result, 
  aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Selection, shape = PopReplicate), 
             size = 4, alpha = 0.75) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", var_expl_percent[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", var_expl_percent[2], "%)")) +
   scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
    values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
    values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
  labs(shape = "Replicate")
  
print(pca_biplot_Sel)
```

#### Scree Plot

```{r}
scree_pcs <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "PC5", "PC6", "PC7", "PC8")
scree_tibble <- tibble(PC = scree_pcs, percent_var = var_expl_percent)

pca_scree <- ggplot(data = scree_tibble, aes(x = PC, y = percent_var)) + 
  geom_col(fill = 'lightgreen', color = 'darkgreen') +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent_var),  vjust = 2, color = 'black', size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult=c(0,0.05))) +
  labs(y = "% Variance Explained", x = "Principal Component")+
  theme_cowplot()


print(pca_scree)
```

#### Patchwork plot assembly

```{r}
PCA_fig <- pca_scree/pca_biplot_Sel+ 
  #plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
  title = "Principal Component Analysis of Genomic Data",
  tag_levels = 'A'
) & theme_cowplot()

print(PCA_fig)
```

#### Save figure

```{r}
ggsave(PCA_fig, filename = "../../Plots/PCA_fig.jpeg", dpi = 400, width = 6, height = 8)
```
